name: event-target-auth-failed

graded_by.test: core/internal/session/create_test.go — TestAnAuthFailedIsAuditedWithoutTheSecret: a refused supplied login writes one target.auth_failed naming the principal and the target, a refused stored credential writes none, and no value of the login is in the line

description: A typed login makes TSB a place to guess a target's passwords from, and a refused create writes no audit line, so a refused supplied login is audited: target.auth_failed, naming the TSB principal who made the create (user, never the target account), the target and the connection, with detail.login supplied. It is written only for a refused supplied login; a refused stored credential stays as it was, with no event. There is no session, so no session_id; and no password, no key and none of the device's own reason text is in the line.

instances.note: the principal, the target, the connection
no connection id when the worker had none
only a supplied login is audited here
never the device's reason text: detail is closed
